items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Krupa was playing that way for Benny Goodman. [INTERVIEWEE] Right, right, he certainly was.

ctx.x: Right. Well, like, see, we explained earlier, that was that shimmy beat thing we used to talk about, that five-stroke roll. And Baby Dodds and Zutty Singleton, all that come out of the New Orleans type of drumming.
Krupa was playing that way for Benny Goodman.
